contactId.title: Contact ID
contactId.description: The Salesforce Contact ID of the customer whose active policy to display

messagingSessionId.title: Messaging Session ID
messagingSessionId.description: The Messaging Session ID — used to resolve the Contact when Policy ID and Contact ID are not available

policyId.title: Policy ID
policyId.description: The Insurance_Policy__c record Id to display. If blank, the contact's most recent Active policy is used.
